column1: # IRL Explore word list v1 (Phase 17G-1). Read ONLY by the app (ExploreLexicon): the words a person types are understood on
# the phone and never leave it. One line: kind, code, terms separated by | (a term may be several words).
# DRAFT FOR REVIEW (decision G-6): the Tamil and Tanglish terms below are a first draft and have NOT been checked by a Tamil
# reader. Known limit: Tamil words take endings (suffixes), and only the forms written here are recognised; a form that is
# missing is shown to the person as "We did not use: ..." and is simply not searched. Add forms here as they are found.
# kind = CATEGORY (code = one of the 10 place categories), FACET (code = a tag of explore-facets-v1.tsv), DAYPART
#        (MORNING | AFTERNOON | EVENING | NIGHT), NEGATION (code -), STOP (code -: a word that means nothing for the search).
# Terms are compared after lower-casing and replacing every character that is not a letter, a digit or a Tamil sign with a
# space. A term may appear once in the whole file (ExploreLexiconTest). The tag names of explore-facets-v1.tsv (English,
# Tamil, Tanglish) are added automatically and need not be repeated here.
# Deliberately NOT understood: negation ("not crowded" is shown as unused), ranking words ("best", "top"), and anything
# about safety (no tag exists for it; Nearby covers conditions).
